TITLE: HIMENO
ROLE: Public Safety Devil Hunter (Special Division 4)
DEVIL / CONTRACT: The Ghost Devil
QUOTE: "Don't die, Aki. I want you to cry for me when I die."
BIO: A hardened veteran of Public Safety's deadliest assignments, Himeno wears an eyepatch—the price of her right eye paid to the Ghost Devil—and masks her deep survivor's guilt behind nicotine, cheap beer, and cheerful teasing. Having watched five previous partners die in the line of duty, her singular goal is pulling Aki Hayakawa out of the Devil Hunter meat grinder alive, a devotion that ultimately drives her to offer every last piece of her body to the Ghost Devil to save him.
